book_interior.book1: A Shakespeare script sits on the shelf.
book2: Usher's name is written as the author.
...It's a thick book, but only about ten pages are actually written on.
book3:
To Flora.
Flora, I went to the cafe this evening and thought of you.
Maybe it's best not to read any further.
book_interior.book4: There are way too many words. Just looking at it gives me a headache.
book_interior.book5: This month's new releases are on display.
book_interior.music1: A record you can put in the jukebox. Did Usher compose all of these?

cafe_interior.oven: A warm oven, still radiating heat. It smells like fresh bread.
grinder: The grinder is full of freshly ground coffee beans.
...Maybe I'll grab a cup of coffee.
cafe_interior.jam: Strawberry jam, apple jam, grape jam... all kinds of jam are lined up here.
beberage: A drink with a cute little chick sticker on it.
bread: Unfortunately, none of it seems to be for sale.
cafe_interior.doll1: The cafe's mascot - a big plush chick.
cafe_interior.doll2: The cafe's mascot - a big plush chick.

farm_interior.flower: A pot with a single flower in it. Nice for setting the mood.
farm_interior.seed: Seeds for planting in the field. You can buy them from Flora.
farm_interior.vase: A wooden pot with a plant growing lush inside. Did Woody make this pot too?

fish_interior.fish1: A fishing rod. Careful not to prick yourself on the hook.
fish_interior.box: An ice box, handy for fishing.
fish_interior.fish2: Dried mackerel. A bit fishy, but it smells delicious.

furniture_interior.bed: A bed with a sturdy frame. Feel free to lie down - it's nice and soft!
furniture_interior.sofa: A two-seater sofa. Great both as decor and as everyday furniture.
furniture_interior.shelf: A bookshelf made of spruce wood. We can adjust it to whatever height you like.
furniture_interior.chair: A classic wooden chair. Try lifting it - it's surprisingly light!
furniture_interior.drawer: Dressers are made to order as soon as we take your request. Just tell us the design you want.
furniture_interior.ref: A beverage fridge. We'll even install it for you.
furniture_interior.carpet: A wool carpet dyed with natural materials.
furniture_interior.picture: A painting by the famous artist Yuja. It's the real thing.

general_interior.door: This must be Marr's private space. Better not go in without permission.
general_interior.goods: Items sold at Marr's general store are on display here.
general_interior.calc: A checkout counter shared by the whole village.

drags: Full of medicines with names too complicated to pronounce.

pasture_interior.feed: A big pile of feed for the animals.
record: A logbook recording the animals' health.
This must be Belze's handwriting? It's really cute.
pasture_interior.trough: A trough filled to the brim with water.
lamp: A small lamp, always lit even at night.
Looks like it's there for the animals that are afraid of the dark.

police_interior.board: A board with case files pinned up. There's a rough-looking face pinned to it.
cabinet: An old filing cabinet, locked shut.
Pulling on the handle doesn't budge it.
shelf: Feels like I shouldn't open these without permission.
police_interior.jail: A jail cell with a small window. Hopefully I never end up in here.

shrine_interior.talisman: Protective talismans hang here. Did Sage make these herself?
plum_pot: A pot with a plum blossom planted in it.
...It seems to be blooming out of season somehow.
shrine_interior.lantern: A traditional hexagonal lantern. It glows softly once night falls.

statue: A Buddha statue. Looking closely, it's been polished to a subtle shine.
A faint scent of incense drifts past.
donation_box: If I opened it without permission, Poli would probably arrest me, right?
